facts.en: Completed a publishing diploma at Fictional Quartzleaf Academy in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构石英叶学院完成出版文凭课程。

facts.en: Attended a 2024-03 introductory structured-authoring course; attendance did not confer an advanced qualification.
facts.zh: 参加 2024-03 结构化写作入门课程；出勤不授予高级资格。

facts.en: Records clerk at Fictional Ink Orchard, 2019-09 to 2021-12.
facts.zh: 2019-09 至 2021-12 在虚构墨果园机构任记录文员。

facts.en: Documentation assistant at Fictional Ink Orchard, 2022-01 to 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2022-01 至 2024-06 在虚构墨果园机构任文档助理。

facts.en: Documentation coordinator at Fictional Ink Orchard, 2024-07 to 2026-09; these roles form continuous employment at the same fictional employer.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2026-09 在虚构墨果园机构任文档协调员；上述岗位构成在同一虚构雇主的连续任职。

facts.en: As a records clerk, filed purchase receipts rather than writing technical instructions.
facts.zh: 任记录文员时归档采购收据，并非撰写技术说明。

facts.en: In the coordinator role, maintains release-note drafts and routes technical statements to engineers.
facts.zh: 任协调员期间维护发布说明草稿，并将技术表述转交工程师。

facts.en: Tracks reviewer responses for 19 active guides in 2026-09; a migration peak involved 31 guides in 2025-02.
facts.zh: 2026-09 跟踪 19 份活跃指南的审阅回复；2025-02 迁移高峰涉及 31 份指南。

facts.en: Joined an installation-guide revision with an engineer and editor during 2025-05 to 2025-07.
facts.zh: 2025-05 至 2025-07 与工程师及编辑共同参与安装指南修订。

facts.en: Personally reorganized headings and wrote screenshot captions for 14 sections; the engineer approved procedural accuracy.
facts.zh: 个人为 14 个章节重组标题并撰写截图说明；操作准确性由工程师批准。

facts.en: Reviewers accepted 11 of 14 sections on the first review in 2025-08; no support-ticket reduction was measured.
facts.zh: 审阅人员在 2025-08 首次审核中接受 14 个章节中的 11 个；未测量支持工单减少。

facts.en: Published the approved guide revision to the internal documentation site in 2025-09 after editor authorization.
facts.zh: 经编辑授权后，于 2025-09 将获批指南修订发布至内部文档网站。

facts.en: Drafted a public API quick-start outline in 2026-02; no engineer had validated or published it by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草公开 API 快速入门大纲；截至 2026-09 尚无工程师验证或发布。

facts.en: Uses Markdown, Git-based document changes, and issue links.
facts.zh: 使用 Markdown、基于 Git 的文档变更及问题链接。

facts.en: Checks broken links and heading hierarchy before technical review.
facts.zh: 技术审核前检查失效链接及标题层级。

facts.en: In the structured-authoring course, tagged a fictional appliance instruction sample; this was coursework, not employer delivery.
facts.zh: 在结构化写作课程中为虚构家电说明样本添加标记；此为课程作业，并非雇主交付。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Paper Lantern Festival on 2025-10 weekends while retaining the paid coordinator role.
facts.zh: 2025-10 周末为虚构纸灯节做志愿者，同时保持有薪协调员岗位。

facts.en: At the festival, arranged printed signs from organizer-provided text; this was not software documentation.
facts.zh: 在节庆活动中根据组织方提供的文字布置印刷指示牌；此非软件文档工作。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated atlas of 16 imaginary islands in 2023-11.
facts.zh: 2023-11 制作包含 16 座假想岛屿的个人插画地图集。

facts.en: Enjoys folding paper boats and studying cloud shapes.
facts.zh: 爱好折纸船及观察云形。

facts.en: An unsigned summary calls the guide independently authored; the approved project log names shared engineering and editorial work.
facts.zh: 一份未署名总结称指南为独立撰写；批准项目日志记载共同的工程及编辑工作。

facts.en: No independent API verification or software release authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立 API 验证或软件发布权限。
